"""Check whether the identical trend/B&H MDD in the 2016~2026 smoke run is genuine
(trend sleeve fully invested across the whole drawdown) rather than a wiring bug."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, "src")
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/gram")

from korea_quant.index_tsmom_backtest import (  # noqa: E402
    build_total_return_index,
    cd91_daily_growth,
    compute_signals,
    month_end_trading_days,
    simulate,
)
from stage5c_smoke_2016_2026 import load_cd91, load_distributions, load_prices  # noqa: E402

prices = load_prices()
days = pd.DatetimeIndex(prices["date"])
dist = load_distributions(days)
growth = cd91_daily_growth(load_cd91(prices["date"]))
signals = compute_signals(build_total_return_index(prices, dist), growth, month_end_trading_days(days))

trend = simulate(prices, dist, growth, signals)
bench = simulate(prices, dist, growth, signals, always_hold=True)

for label, curve in [("추세", trend), ("B&H", bench)]:
    dd = curve / curve.cummax() - 1.0
    trough = dd.idxmin()
    peak = curve.loc[:trough].idxmax()
    print(f"{label}: 고점={peak.date()} 저점={trough.date()} MDD={-dd.min():.6%}")

# 낙폭 구간 동안 추세가 계속 보유였는지 확인한다.
dd = trend / trend.cummax() - 1.0
trough = dd.idxmin()
peak = trend.loc[:trough].idxmax()
switches = [(s.judged_on.date(), s.hold) for s in signals if peak <= s.judged_on <= trough]
print(f"고점~저점 사이 월말 판정: {switches}")
ratio = (trend / bench).loc[peak:trough]
print(f"고점~저점 추세/B&H 비율 변동폭={float(ratio.max() - ratio.min()):.2e}")
